prompt: Screen me small-cap defense stocks for the next 5 years — show me the workings and the picks
expected_output: Defense-themed report with explicit screening funnel, small/mid-cap only, 4-bullet picks, sources

assertions.name: defense_focus
assertions.description: Output must focus on defense theme
assertions.check: output contains 'defense' AND ('missile' or 'munitions' or 'NDO' or 'backlog' or 'primes' or 'DoD' or 'Pentagon' or 'NDAA')

assertions.name: small_cap_mcap_filter
assertions.description: Output must explicitly apply small-cap mcap filter
assertions.check: output contains 'small' or 'mid-cap' or 'small/mid' or a market cap range

assertions.name: screening_funnel_shown
assertions.description: Output must show the screening funnel with explicit counts
assertions.check: output contains 'universe' AND 'screen' AND at least 2 numeric values

assertions.name: 4_bullets_per_ticker
assertions.description: Output must have all 4 sub-bullets per ticker
assertions.check: output contains 'Thesis fit' AND 'Catalyst' AND 'Valuation' AND 'conviction'

assertions.name: sources_present
assertions.description: Output must have Sources block with URLs

assertions.name: dd_disclaimer_present
assertions.description: Output must end with DD disclaimer
assertions.check: output contains 'Always do your own DD' and 'this is not financial advice'
